subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on June 15th, 2022. Your flight is scheduled to depart at 10:00 AM from JFK International Airport. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure for check-in. We wish you a pleasant journey and look forward to welcoming you on board. Should you have any questions or require assistance, feel free to contact us. Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
